name: Coda
description: Coda's hosted server reads and edits docs, pages and tables, so the agent can update a tracker or a spec where it lives.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (coda.io) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
